visualCharacteristics.sourceCss: Source CSS = the page's inline <style> on top of media.beckman.com/assets/css/styles.css (Bootstrap 3; html font-size 10px so 1rem = 10px; body Gotham → Montserrat stand-in var(--mb-font-family), 16px/1.65 #4d4d4d; .btn: inline-block, padding 13px 20px, 13.5px/22.275px weight 500 → var(--mb-weight-medium, 500), radius 2px, transition .3s; .btn-primary bg #007acb, hover #0065a7; links #007acb, no underline). Source breakpoints 768 and 992 (mark media queries with /* breakpoint-exception: source uses 768/992 */). Font weights in CSS must use var(--mb-weight-regular, 400) / var(--mb-weight-medium, 500) (inner-page tokens).
visualCharacteristics.layout: INTENDED design (live markup bug: .productCard vs CSS .ProductCard, so live shows one card per row at natural image size — DO NOT copy the bug). Source CSS: .ProductCards {display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center} .ProductCard {box-shadow: 0 4px 8px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2); transition: .3s; margin: 10px; padding: 24px; display:flex; flex: 1 1 0; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; min-width: 180px} .ProductCard:hover {box-shadow: 0 8px 16px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.2)} .ProductCard__img {height: 280px; padding: 10px; object-fit: contain} .ProductCard__body h3 {font-size: 1.8rem (18px); font-weight: 500} ≥768: .ProductCard {max-width: 214px}. So at 1440: 4 cards of 214px in one centred row; at 390 cards wrap (each min 180px, flex 1 → one or two per row; with 358px content: 1 per row full width minus 20px margins).
